counts_detail.assessed_population: all 1,975 YV mantras were re-assessed, not only the 223 gap. The 1,752 already-mapped verses were re-scored under the corrected instrument and all 1,752 still map -- zero regressions. candidates_considered counts the 223 open gap keys plus the 11 whole-source candidates evaluated for them.
counts_detail.arithmetic: 223 gap keys = 25 accepted EXACT + 8 accepted UNVERIFIED + 190 rejected. Adding the 11 rejected source candidates gives candidates_considered 234 = accepted 33 + rejected 201 + unresolved 0. The 8 UNVERIFIED rows count as accepted because they are staged as rows; the validator reports them separately as not importable.
counts_detail.residual_198: 190 NO_AUDIO_AT_SOURCE + 8 UNVERIFIED. Every one carries a typed reason, which is GAP-AUDIO-003's second closure clause.

gap_status_proposed.GAP-AUDIO-003: PARTIALLY_CLOSED_REMAINDER_BLOCKED_RIGHTS_AND_GRANULARITY -- NOT BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE. Madhyandina audio covering the remaining 198 exists and is live today at IGNCA; it is permission-blocked and published per adhyaya, not absent. See proofs/ignca-madhyandina-live.md.

qa.sampling_detail: 25 of 25 accepted rows (100%): real audio fetched from the live API, every one decoded as MP3, 88-288 KB. 60 control rows already accepted by the shipped pipeline: audio fetched to establish a bytes-per-text-letter band of 414.8-978.6 (median 527.4); all 25 accepted rows fall inside it, at 418.9-853.1, so none is a long recording attached to one mantra -- a whole adhyaya at that rate would be ~2,852 KB against a largest accepted file of 281 KB. 25 distinct recordings; no recording is shared between two keys. 8 of 8 residue coordinates fetched: all carry real MP3, so their blocker is text verification, not absence. 40 of the 190 NO_AUDIO_AT_SOURCE rows re-probed live 2026-09-15: 0 flipped. Adversarially, each of the 33 was also scored against all 1,975 source rows to test the numbering-offset hypothesis, which it disproved. The 2 defects_found are the two instrument defects reported in the companion document; zero defects were found in the 33 rows themselves.
qa.not_verified: No row carries duration_seconds, because no duration was decoded -- it is unknown, not zero. No human has heard any of these 33 recordings; human_reviewed is 0 and no row claims otherwise. The 25 EXACT rows rest on the source's own statement of what each file recites, matched against our text: the same two-safeguard basis as the 1,752 rows already in the catalogue, and no stronger.
